verdict: Credentials take an afternoon. Going live depends entirely on scopes: send-only needs a standard review, anything that reads mail triggers Google's strictest review plus a paid yearly security assessment.
start_now: If your agent reads email, submit for verification the day you know your scopes. The security assessment runs on Google's clock, not yours.

cases.case: Only your company's Google Workspace accounts (Internal app)
Read, modify or full mail access (restricted scopes)
cases.outcome: Verification + CASA security assessment, renewed every 12 months

steps.title: Create a Google Cloud project and enable the Gmail API
Pick the smallest scope set for your features
steps.detail: Map each feature to one scope. Drop anything you don't call; one restricted scope pulls the whole app into the strict track.

steps.title: Configure the consent screen
steps.detail: App name, support email, logo, homepage, privacy policy URL, authorized domain. Internal vs External audience is chosen here.

steps.title: Create a Web OAuth client
steps.detail: Add your redirect URL (for Composio: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add). Copy client ID and secret.

steps.title: Test with up to 100 test users
steps.detail: Unverified apps show a warning screen and have a user cap. Fine for building, not for launch.

steps.title: Draft the verification package
steps.detail: Scope justifications, demo video script, privacy policy checklist.

steps.title: Google reviews the app
steps.detail: Brand check, then scope review. Restricted scopes add a CASA assessment by a Google-approved lab.

blockers.text: Composio's Gmail form pre-selects https://mail.google.com/ (full mail access), a restricted scope. Keeping the default puts you on the hardest track.
gmail.readonly, gmail.modify, gmail.compose and gmail.metadata are all restricted. There is no 'light' way to read mail.
CASA assessment costs a few hundred to a few thousand dollars a year, from third-party estimates.
Scopes in your code must match the consent screen, or users keep seeing the unverified-app warning.
Exact review times for restricted scopes are not published by Google.

agent_can: Map your features to the minimum scopes
Flag restricted scopes before you submit
Draft scope justifications and the demo video script
Check your privacy policy covers Google's required disclosures
you_must: Own the Google Cloud project and domain
Hire and work with a CASA assessor (restricted scopes)
Click submit and answer Google's emails
unverified: Review times above are ranges from developer reports, not Google commitments
Assessment cost depends on the lab and tier
